text: PMI-Minnesota Depository Documents Selected by Plaintiffs
Contributors: Ingrid Messner, Paula Decker, Original Beta Team,
Mary Counts, Bernie Laroy, Bruce Losce, Connie Nichols, Ulysses
“Alternative Smoking Devices and New Products” Detailed
presentation on the history of alternative smoking devices. The
presentation features patents and diagrams of alternative smoking
devices from 1978 to 1993 which heat rather than burn tobacco. In
addition, the presentation includes diagrams of batteries used to
generate electricity to heat tobacco. The presentation discusses PM
projects titled Beta, Sigma, and Delta. In addition, the presentation
mentions RJ.R.'s alternative smoking device called Premier.
